meta.siteTitle: Your Digital Invitation to Arina & Elnur's Wedding Ceremony
meta.description: You are warmly invited to Arina & Elnur's wedding ceremony at the Schlosskirche in Eller Düsseldorf, Germany. Join us for a special celebration of love and unity.
meta.ogDescription: You are warmly invited to Arina & Elnur's wedding ceremony at the Schlosskirche in Eller Düsseldorf, Germany. Join us for a special celebration of love and unity.
meta.twitterDescription: You are warmly invited to Arina & Elnur's wedding ceremony.

paragraphs: We met at church, became friends, and somewhere along the way friendship quietly turned into love.
On 02.03, we got engaged — a promise we now carry toward 2026, when we will celebrate our marriage with out loved ones.
Above all, we are grateful for the life God is building in us, and for the joy of serving our Lord together.

agenda.label: GET TOGETHER
agenda.title: Hangout · Bring & Share
agenda.description: Arrive, meet familiar faces, and settle in before the ceremony begins.

agenda.label: CEREMONY
agenda.title: Ceremony Start
agenda.description: Please take your seat before 14:00 so we can start on time. We kindly ask you to put your phones away and enjoy the moment with us. Our photographer and videographer will take care of capturing the ceremony.

agenda.label: RECEPTION
agenda.title: Bring & Share Reception
agenda.description: After the ceremony, we'll gather outside the church building for snacks and drinks — and some time together. You're very welcome to bring something to share. ❤️

dressCode.intro: Elegant classic attire in soft neutrals and deep classic tones.
dressCode.note: Please avoid neon tones and very bright patterns.

faq.question: Can I bring a plus one?
faq.answer: Please follow your invite. We would love to have our dear ones but have a limited number of seats in the church.

faq.question: Are there any parking spots?
faq.answer: Yes! There are some directly at the church, as well as near the houses around it, and a bigger parking area within walking distance.

faq.question: Is there a wish list?
faq.answer: No wish list — honestly, having you there is the best gift of all. There'll be a gift box at the church (and at the venue too, for the evening), so there's no need to send anything in advance.

faq.question: Is there any place for kids?
faq.answer: Kids are more than welcome! We would kindly ask that they sit or play in the kids' space at the back of the church during the ceremony. Thank you ❤️

faq.question: When should I arrive?
faq.answer: Please arrive by 13:30 to find your seat and settle in before the ceremony begins at 14:00.

faq.question: Who can I contact?
faq.answer: The best man or maid of honor are your go-to contacts — find them in the Crew section.
